name: savant-colosseum-desktop
description: Colosseum Desktop shell for multi-worker execution observability and task drill-down.
author: Savant

scripts.rebuild:native: mkdir -p node_modules && cp -R ../node_modules/better-sqlite3 node_modules/ 2>/dev/null || true; npx @electron/rebuild -v 41.7.1 -f -m node_modules/better-sqlite3
scripts.dev:electron: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist-electron', { recursive: true, force: true })" && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5175 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5175 electron .
scripts.build: vite build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist-electron', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && electron-builder
scripts.build:electron: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist-electron', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json
